title: They have a short. VERY short life span
text:
They have a short. VERY short life span. I love my Ball jars. I have them in all sizes.

Big fan...however, about 10 months after purchase and normal use they started to crack at the bottom.

I do not use ours for canning. We use the larger jars for storing filtered water in the fridge. So they are never frozen nor exposed to extreme heat.

At first I thought it was just my fault. Perhaps I put loaded them in the dishwasher in the wrong way. Perhaps I cracked them by mistake and did not realize...but now, having only five left (and we ordered three large boxes of them! So initially we had over 30 jars) I finally have come to the conclussion that this is simply a MANUFACTURING FLAW.

All of other sizes, which we use in similar manner to the larger jars, are fine. None of them has ever cracked. Only the larger ones.

I thought we were making an investment on buying American made quality. I am so very very sad to have thrown so much money in the trash by purchasing these larger size jars. Again, at least three large boxes of the large jars. That's quite a bit of money to toss into the recycling bin.

So, no, NO, NO, I would NOT recommend the large size.
